name: det_adwin
description: Detection-only reference: Hoeffding Tree (library defaults) + ADWIN delta=0.01 with MOA ADWINChangeDetector semantics (window not reset after a detection, only increases of the input mean count), fed int(y == y_pred) after the first 25% of the input stream; the tree is never reset. Reproduces Cerqueira et al.'s hypertuned ADWIN.
source: Cerqueira et al. 2026 (github.com/vcerqueira/experiments-drift_evaluation): src/prequential_workflow.py SupervisedStreamingWorkflow, src/config.py DETECTOR_SYNTH_PARAMS ADWIN delta 0.01; CapyMOA ADWIN wraps moa.classifiers.core.driftdetection.ADWINChangeDetector
